best_for: Graphic designers wanting to bring their static designs to life
Social media managers needing custom animated content
Video editors looking to add basic title animation to their skills
not_for: Those looking for advanced 3D character animation
Advanced motion designers seeking broadcast-level workflows
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Absolute beginners should take Adobe Illustrator Fundamentals first to understand vector design.

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of vector graphics (Illustrator) and layers.
prerequisites.recommended: Familiarity with the Adobe Creative Cloud ecosystem.

system_requirements.hardware: Multi-core processor, 16GB RAM minimum, Dedicated GPU.

overview.positioning: The perfect bridge course for designers moving from static imagery to dynamic motion.
overview.short_description: Learn the core principles of 2D animation, vector manipulation, and kinetic typography in After Effects.

key_facts.career_focus: Junior Motion Designer, Hybrid Graphic Designer

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Animate logos and icons with smooth easing
Export animations for web (Lottie) and video (MP4/MOV)

why_now.industry_shift: Clients no longer accept just a static logo; they expect a full brand identity including motion guidelines and animated assets.
why_now.ai_impact: While AI can generate video, precise brand-compliant vector animation still requires manual keyframing and design software.
why_now.business_demand: Agencies prefer hiring 'hybrid' designers who can design the asset in Illustrator and animate it in After Effects.
why_now.career_opportunity: Adding 'Motion Graphics' to a graphic design portfolio increases hireability significantly.

learning_outcomes: PREPARE: Structure vector assets for seamless import.
ANIMATE: Apply the principles of animation using keyframes and the graph editor.
AUTOMATE: Use shape layer modifiers like Trim Paths to speed up workflows.
DELIVER: Export alpha-channel graphics for video editors or JSON/Lottie for web.

stages.focus: Vector preparation and AE interface basics.
Keyframing, easing, and shape layer animation.
Typography and final brand package export.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Keyframing, easing, shape layers, and text animators.
core_tools.what_student_builds: Logo animations, UI elements, kinetic text.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Releasing to layers and anchor point prep.

stages.name: Prep
stages.desc: Organizing layers and importing as a composition in AE.

stages.name: Animate
stages.desc: Applying motion and adjusting the speed graph.

stages.name: Export
stages.desc: Rendering for the specific medium (Web, Social, or Video Editor handoff).

business_use_cases.business_problem: A client needs a logo reveal for their YouTube channel.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: N/A (Focus is on precise vector keyframing).
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Brand-specific timing and physics of motion.

best_practices: Never import a flat .AI file; always 'Release to Layers (Sequence)'.
Use the graph editor on every single animation.
Keep anchor points logical (e.g., at the base of a swinging pendulum).

common_mistakes.professional_approach: Apply Easy Ease (F9) as a baseline for everything.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to handle both static design and basic animation in-house.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A solid foundation in bringing vector art to life.

what_you_will_build: A bouncing ball and pendulum (physics practice)
An animated icon set for a website
final_deliverables: An animated brand package (Logo, Lower Third, Outro).

assessment.criteria: Proper file preparation, smooth easing, and technical correctness.

certification.title: Nova Certificate in Motion Graphics Essentials

not_covered: Live-action VFX, 3D modeling, advanced character rigging.

faq.question: I don't know how to draw. Can I take this course?
faq.answer: Yes! We provide the Illustrator files for you, and motion graphics is more about manipulating existing art than drawing from scratch.

modules.module_purpose: Bridge the gap between Illustrator and After Effects.

lessons.what_is_taught: Releasing layers in Illustrator and importing as a composition.
lessons.why_it_matters: If you don't prep the file, you can't animate the individual parts.
lessons.what_learner_does: Prepares a complex vector logo and imports it correctly.

lessons.what_is_taught: Position, Scale, Rotation keyframes, and using the speed graph.
lessons.why_it_matters: Easing creates the illusion of weight and physics.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a bouncing ball and a swinging pendulum.

lessons.what_is_taught: Applying basic principles (anticipation, overshoot) to UI icons.
lessons.why_it_matters: Micro-interactions are huge in web design.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a 'Like' heart and a 'Send' paper airplane.

modules.hands_on_practice: Prep and animate a 3-piece icon set.

modules.module_purpose: Master AE's native vector tools to build a complete animated brand identity.

lessons.what_is_taught: Converting vectors to shape layers and using Trim Paths.
lessons.why_it_matters: The standard technique for drawing on lines and animating signatures.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a logo drawing itself on screen.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using shapes to mask text (alpha mattes) and basic text animators.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds an animated lower-third name graphic.

lessons.what_is_taught: Exporting MP4s, ProRes with Alpha (transparency), and intro to Bodymovin/Lottie.
lessons.why_it_matters: You must know how to hand off files to video editors or web developers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Compiles their logo and lower third into a final package and exports.

modules.hands_on_practice: Complete the final logo animation and lower third.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to deliver professional motion graphics assets.
